<script>
// modal video embed auto-play and auto-shut-up
// Read src/type from Bootstrap's event.relatedTarget so we never stash across
// handlers (survives button re-renders from A/B, GTM, etc.).
jQuery(document).ready(function() {
  function getEmbedTrigger(event) {
    var related = event.relatedTarget;
    if (!related) {
      return jQuery();
    }
    var $related = jQuery(related);
    if ($related.is('[data-toggle="modal"][data-type]')) {
      return $related;
    }
    return $related.closest('[data-toggle="modal"][data-type]');
  }

  // Demo only: show loader as soon as the modal starts opening
  jQuery('#modalEmbedDemo').on('show.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    if ($trigger.data('type') !== 'demo' || !$trigger.data('src')) {
      return;
    }

    jQuery(this).find('.modal-body').html(
      '<div class="demo-embed-wrap">' +
        '<div class="demo-embed-loading" aria-live="polite" aria-busy="true">' +
          '<span class="demo-embed-spinner" role="status" aria-label="Loading demo"></span>' +
          '<div class="demo-embed-error">' +
            'Unable to load the demo. ' +
            '<a href="' + $trigger.data('src') + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Open it in a new tab</a>.' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>'
    );
  });

  // Demo only: inject Guideflow after modal is fully shown/sized
  jQuery('#modalEmbedDemo').on('shown.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var modal = jQuery(this);
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    var src = $trigger.data('src');
    var $wrap = modal.find('.demo-embed-wrap');
    var $loading = modal.find('.demo-embed-loading');
    var revealed = false;
    var loadTimedOut = false;

    if ($trigger.data('type') !== 'demo' || !src || !$wrap.length) {
      return;
    }

    var $iframe = jQuery(
      '<iframe width="100%" height="100%" scrolling="no" allow="clipboard-read; clipboard-write" ' +
      'webkitallowfullscreen mozallowfullscreen allowfullscreen allowtransparency="true"></iframe>'
    );

    function revealDemo() {
      if (revealed || loadTimedOut) {
        return;
      }
      revealed = true;
      $loading.addClass('is-done').attr('aria-busy', 'false');
      $iframe.addClass('is-ready');
    }

    function showDemoError() {
      if (revealed) {
        return;
      }
      loadTimedOut = true;
      $loading.addClass('is-error').attr('aria-busy', 'false');
    }

    $iframe.on('load', revealDemo);
    $wrap.append($iframe);
    $iframe.attr('src', src);

    // If Guideflow never loads, show an error + direct link instead of a blank iframe
    window.setTimeout(showDemoError, 8000);
  });

  // Other embed modals: same relatedTarget pattern, no visual changes
  jQuery('#modalEmbed, #modalEmbedDarkMode').on('shown.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var modal = jQuery(this);
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    var src = $trigger.data('src');
    var type = $trigger.data('type');
    var modalBody = modal.find('.modal-body');
    var iframe;

    if (!src || !type) {
      return;
    }

    if (type === 'pardot' || type === 'embed') {
      iframe = modalBody.html('<iframe width="100%" height="450" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>').children('iframe');

      if (type === 'pardot') {
        iframe.on('load', function() {
          iFrameResize();
        });
        iframe.attr('src', src);
      }
      if (type === 'embed') {
        iframe.attr('src', src + '?autoplay=1&enablejsapi=1&rel=0');
        ytTracker.init();
      }
    }
  });

  jQuery('.modal-in-footer').on('hidden.bs.modal', function() {
    jQuery(this).find('.modal-body').html('');
  });
});
</script>

<script>
// modal video embed auto-play and auto-shut-up
// Read src/type from Bootstrap's event.relatedTarget so we never stash across
// handlers (survives button re-renders from A/B, GTM, etc.).
jQuery(document).ready(function() {
  function getEmbedTrigger(event) {
    var related = event.relatedTarget;
    if (!related) {
      return jQuery();
    }
    var $related = jQuery(related);
    if ($related.is('[data-toggle="modal"][data-type]')) {
      return $related;
    }
    return $related.closest('[data-toggle="modal"][data-type]');
  }

  // Demo only: show loader as soon as the modal starts opening
  jQuery('#modalEmbedDemo').on('show.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    if ($trigger.data('type') !== 'demo' || !$trigger.data('src')) {
      return;
    }

    jQuery(this).find('.modal-body').html(
      '<div class="demo-embed-wrap">' +
        '<div class="demo-embed-loading" aria-live="polite" aria-busy="true">' +
          '<span class="demo-embed-spinner" role="status" aria-label="Loading demo"></span>' +
          '<div class="demo-embed-error">' +
            'Unable to load the demo. ' +
            '<a href="' + $trigger.data('src') + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Open it in a new tab</a>.' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>'
    );
  });

  // Demo only: inject Guideflow after modal is fully shown/sized
  jQuery('#modalEmbedDemo').on('shown.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var modal = jQuery(this);
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    var src = $trigger.data('src');
    var $wrap = modal.find('.demo-embed-wrap');
    var $loading = modal.find('.demo-embed-loading');
    var revealed = false;
    var loadTimedOut = false;

    if ($trigger.data('type') !== 'demo' || !src || !$wrap.length) {
      return;
    }

    var $iframe = jQuery(
      '<iframe width="100%" height="100%" scrolling="no" allow="clipboard-read; clipboard-write" ' +
      'webkitallowfullscreen mozallowfullscreen allowfullscreen allowtransparency="true"></iframe>'
    );

    function revealDemo() {
      if (revealed || loadTimedOut) {
        return;
      }
      revealed = true;
      $loading.addClass('is-done').attr('aria-busy', 'false');
      $iframe.addClass('is-ready');
    }

    function showDemoError() {
      if (revealed) {
        return;
      }
      loadTimedOut = true;
      $loading.addClass('is-error').attr('aria-busy', 'false');
    }

    $iframe.on('load', revealDemo);
    $wrap.append($iframe);
    $iframe.attr('src', src);

    // If Guideflow never loads, show an error + direct link instead of a blank iframe
    window.setTimeout(showDemoError, 8000);
  });

  // Other embed modals: same relatedTarget pattern, no visual changes
  jQuery('#modalEmbed, #modalEmbedDarkMode').on('shown.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var modal = jQuery(this);
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    var src = $trigger.data('src');
    var type = $trigger.data('type');
    var modalBody = modal.find('.modal-body');
    var iframe;

    if (!src || !type) {
      return;
    }

    if (type === 'pardot' || type === 'embed') {
      iframe = modalBody.html('<iframe width="100%" height="450" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>').children('iframe');

      if (type === 'pardot') {
        iframe.on('load', function() {
          iFrameResize();
        });
        iframe.attr('src', src);
      }
      if (type === 'embed') {
        iframe.attr('src', src + '?autoplay=1&enablejsapi=1&rel=0');
        ytTracker.init();
      }
    }
  });

  jQuery('.modal-in-footer').on('hidden.bs.modal', function() {
    jQuery(this).find('.modal-body').html('');
  });
});
</script>

At Criteo, Google Privacy Sandbox is just one of three approaches we’ll apply to solve addressability in 2024 and beyond. Life without cookies could be sweeter than you think. Contact Sales Addressability in the post-cookie age. As simple as 1, 2, 3. As an independent ad tech company, we’re uniquely positioned to deliver the solution(s) that work best for each of our partners. How do we do it? With three core pillars. 1. First-Party Data In a world without third-party cookies, first-party data is king. At Criteo we’ve already built a unique shopper graph across both the demand and supply side. This enables privacy-safe activation via solutions like hashed emails at scale—and maintains 1:1 addressability across the ecosystem. 2. Google Privacy Sandbox We’ve been a leading partner of the Google Chrome team since the earliest days of the Privacy Sandbox . This partnership ensures we can enable retargeting, interest-based advertising, and measurement across 63% of global browser traffic—and all without third-party cookies. 3. Closed Environments With retail and social media audiences, you get the best of both worlds with Criteo. Our strategy connects partners to audiences from 200+ retailers via our Retail Media Network—as well as millions of logged-in users on social platforms like Meta. Our approach to addressability in 90 seconds. Hear from our Chief Product Officer, Todd Parsons, as he outlines our multi-pronged approach to addressability. Have a spare 15 minutes? Watch the full webinar for the complete picture. Watch the full 15-minute webinar Witness the future of addressability Want to dive deeper into addressability strategy, testing, and insights live and in person? We have several speaking events coming up, so be sure to check out the schedule and experience our strategy first-hand. See our events Hot off the press The world of addressability moves pretty fast. To be sure you don’t miss any of the latest developments, we've curated the essential addressability articles from across the open web. Read the latest Master addressability at Criteo Commerce Academy Our new “Addressability & Third Party Cookies” course is now live on Criteo Commerce Academy. This self-paced e-learning course is open to all and designed to help you understand third-party cookie deprecation, industry changes and their impact, as well as Criteo’s Addressability Strategy. Get certified GETTING STARTED The future is not one-size-fits-all With so many solutions out there, you might be feeling some analysis paralysis. Don’t worry—we’ve developed tailored strategies to help our partners across the ecosystem effortlessly solve the addressability puzzle. Media Owners Ad inventory is much more valuable when advertisers know which audiences they’re reaching. Without a robust addressability solution, advertisers will be in the dark, meaning media owner revenue is at risk. At Criteo, we built our strategy to support media owners by preserving the value of their inventory to maintain the monetization they rely on. Learn more about addressability for media owners Brands For brands, it’s all about delivering the right message, to the right person, at the right time. By safeguarding tools like frequency capping, measurement, and creative personalization—without compromising performance—our addressability solutions help brands to keep doing what they do best. Learn more about addressability for brands Retailers With the ability to operate on both the demand and supply side, retailers occupy a unique corner of our ecosystem. But whether monetizing data assets or looking to drive measurable performance for their own campaigns, retailers need robust addressability solutions to maintain revenue streams—and create new ones. Learn more about addressability for retailers Agencies Delivering—and proving—value for clients in the post-cookie age will be a challenge. With Criteo’s solutions, agencies can continue to report on key metrics like ROAS, even in cookie-compromised environments. Learn more about addressability for agencies 138% Increased CPMs for Safari traffic Customer Story “We partnered with Criteo to monetize our inventory more effectively in cookieless environments. We are thrilled with this progress and will continue to work together with strategic partners like Criteo to navigate the future state of high-value, personalized advertising.” Molly Gallagher | Senior Manager, Programmatic Revenue at Slate Want to stay in the loop? The addressability landscape can change rapidly. That’s why we created our regular Addressability Newsletter. <script>
// modal video embed auto-play and auto-shut-up
// Read src/type from Bootstrap's event.relatedTarget so we never stash across
// handlers (survives button re-renders from A/B, GTM, etc.).
jQuery(document).ready(function() {
  function getEmbedTrigger(event) {
    var related = event.relatedTarget;
    if (!related) {
      return jQuery();
    }
    var $related = jQuery(related);
    if ($related.is('[data-toggle="modal"][data-type]')) {
      return $related;
    }
    return $related.closest('[data-toggle="modal"][data-type]');
  }

  // Demo only: show loader as soon as the modal starts opening
  jQuery('#modalEmbedDemo').on('show.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    if ($trigger.data('type') !== 'demo' || !$trigger.data('src')) {
      return;
    }

    jQuery(this).find('.modal-body').html(
      '<div class="demo-embed-wrap">' +
        '<div class="demo-embed-loading" aria-live="polite" aria-busy="true">' +
          '<span class="demo-embed-spinner" role="status" aria-label="Loading demo"></span>' +
          '<div class="demo-embed-error">' +
            'Unable to load the demo. ' +
            '<a href="' + $trigger.data('src') + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Open it in a new tab</a>.' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>'
    );
  });

  // Demo only: inject Guideflow after modal is fully shown/sized
  jQuery('#modalEmbedDemo').on('shown.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var modal = jQuery(this);
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    var src = $trigger.data('src');
    var $wrap = modal.find('.demo-embed-wrap');
    var $loading = modal.find('.demo-embed-loading');
    var revealed = false;
    var loadTimedOut = false;

    if ($trigger.data('type') !== 'demo' || !src || !$wrap.length) {
      return;
    }

    var $iframe = jQuery(
      '<iframe width="100%" height="100%" scrolling="no" allow="clipboard-read; clipboard-write" ' +
      'webkitallowfullscreen mozallowfullscreen allowfullscreen allowtransparency="true"></iframe>'
    );

    function revealDemo() {
      if (revealed || loadTimedOut) {
        return;
      }
      revealed = true;
      $loading.addClass('is-done').attr('aria-busy', 'false');
      $iframe.addClass('is-ready');
    }

    function showDemoError() {
      if (revealed) {
        return;
      }
      loadTimedOut = true;
      $loading.addClass('is-error').attr('aria-busy', 'false');
    }

    $iframe.on('load', revealDemo);
    $wrap.append($iframe);
    $iframe.attr('src', src);

    // If Guideflow never loads, show an error + direct link instead of a blank iframe
    window.setTimeout(showDemoError, 8000);
  });

  // Other embed modals: same relatedTarget pattern, no visual changes
  jQuery('#modalEmbed, #modalEmbedDarkMode').on('shown.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var modal = jQuery(this);
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    var src = $trigger.data('src');
    var type = $trigger.data('type');
    var modalBody = modal.find('.modal-body');
    var iframe;

    if (!src || !type) {
      return;
    }

    if (type === 'pardot' || type === 'embed') {
      iframe = modalBody.html('<iframe width="100%" height="450" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>').children('iframe');

      if (type === 'pardot') {
        iframe.on('load', function() {
          iFrameResize();
        });
        iframe.attr('src', src);
      }
      if (type === 'embed') {
        iframe.attr('src', src + '?autoplay=1&enablejsapi=1&rel=0');
        ytTracker.init();
      }
    }
  });

  jQuery('.modal-in-footer').on('hidden.bs.modal', function() {
    jQuery(this).find('.modal-body').html('');
  });
});
</script>

<script>
// modal video embed auto-play and auto-shut-up
// Read src/type from Bootstrap's event.relatedTarget so we never stash across
// handlers (survives button re-renders from A/B, GTM, etc.).
jQuery(document).ready(function() {
  function getEmbedTrigger(event) {
    var related = event.relatedTarget;
    if (!related) {
      return jQuery();
    }
    var $related = jQuery(related);
    if ($related.is('[data-toggle="modal"][data-type]')) {
      return $related;
    }
    return $related.closest('[data-toggle="modal"][data-type]');
  }

  // Demo only: show loader as soon as the modal starts opening
  jQuery('#modalEmbedDemo').on('show.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    if ($trigger.data('type') !== 'demo' || !$trigger.data('src')) {
      return;
    }

    jQuery(this).find('.modal-body').html(
      '<div class="demo-embed-wrap">' +
        '<div class="demo-embed-loading" aria-live="polite" aria-busy="true">' +
          '<span class="demo-embed-spinner" role="status" aria-label="Loading demo"></span>' +
          '<div class="demo-embed-error">' +
            'Unable to load the demo. ' +
            '<a href="' + $trigger.data('src') + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Open it in a new tab</a>.' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>'
    );
  });

  // Demo only: inject Guideflow after modal is fully shown/sized
  jQuery('#modalEmbedDemo').on('shown.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var modal = jQuery(this);
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    var src = $trigger.data('src');
    var $wrap = modal.find('.demo-embed-wrap');
    var $loading = modal.find('.demo-embed-loading');
    var revealed = false;
    var loadTimedOut = false;

    if ($trigger.data('type') !== 'demo' || !src || !$wrap.length) {
      return;
    }

    var $iframe = jQuery(
      '<iframe width="100%" height="100%" scrolling="no" allow="clipboard-read; clipboard-write" ' +
      'webkitallowfullscreen mozallowfullscreen allowfullscreen allowtransparency="true"></iframe>'
    );

    function revealDemo() {
      if (revealed || loadTimedOut) {
        return;
      }
      revealed = true;
      $loading.addClass('is-done').attr('aria-busy', 'false');
      $iframe.addClass('is-ready');
    }

    function showDemoError() {
      if (revealed) {
        return;
      }
      loadTimedOut = true;
      $loading.addClass('is-error').attr('aria-busy', 'false');
    }

    $iframe.on('load', revealDemo);
    $wrap.append($iframe);
    $iframe.attr('src', src);

    // If Guideflow never loads, show an error + direct link instead of a blank iframe
    window.setTimeout(showDemoError, 8000);
  });

  // Other embed modals: same relatedTarget pattern, no visual changes
  jQuery('#modalEmbed, #modalEmbedDarkMode').on('shown.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var modal = jQuery(this);
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    var src = $trigger.data('src');
    var type = $trigger.data('type');
    var modalBody = modal.find('.modal-body');
    var iframe;

    if (!src || !type) {
      return;
    }

    if (type === 'pardot' || type === 'embed') {
      iframe = modalBody.html('<iframe width="100%" height="450" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>').children('iframe');

      if (type === 'pardot') {
        iframe.on('load', function() {
          iFrameResize();
        });
        iframe.attr('src', src);
      }
      if (type === 'embed') {
        iframe.attr('src', src + '?autoplay=1&enablejsapi=1&rel=0');
        ytTracker.init();
      }
    }
  });

  jQuery('.modal-in-footer').on('hidden.bs.modal', function() {
    jQuery(this).find('.modal-body').html('');
  });
});
</script>

<script>
// modal video embed auto-play and auto-shut-up
// Read src/type from Bootstrap's event.relatedTarget so we never stash across
// handlers (survives button re-renders from A/B, GTM, etc.).
jQuery(document).ready(function() {
  function getEmbedTrigger(event) {
    var related = event.relatedTarget;
    if (!related) {
      return jQuery();
    }
    var $related = jQuery(related);
    if ($related.is('[data-toggle="modal"][data-type]')) {
      return $related;
    }
    return $related.closest('[data-toggle="modal"][data-type]');
  }

  // Demo only: show loader as soon as the modal starts opening
  jQuery('#modalEmbedDemo').on('show.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    if ($trigger.data('type') !== 'demo' || !$trigger.data('src')) {
      return;
    }

    jQuery(this).find('.modal-body').html(
      '<div class="demo-embed-wrap">' +
        '<div class="demo-embed-loading" aria-live="polite" aria-busy="true">' +
          '<span class="demo-embed-spinner" role="status" aria-label="Loading demo"></span>' +
          '<div class="demo-embed-error">' +
            'Unable to load the demo. ' +
            '<a href="' + $trigger.data('src') + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Open it in a new tab</a>.' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>'
    );
  });

  // Demo only: inject Guideflow after modal is fully shown/sized
  jQuery('#modalEmbedDemo').on('shown.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var modal = jQuery(this);
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    var src = $trigger.data('src');
    var $wrap = modal.find('.demo-embed-wrap');
    var $loading = modal.find('.demo-embed-loading');
    var revealed = false;
    var loadTimedOut = false;

    if ($trigger.data('type') !== 'demo' || !src || !$wrap.length) {
      return;
    }

    var $iframe = jQuery(
      '<iframe width="100%" height="100%" scrolling="no" allow="clipboard-read; clipboard-write" ' +
      'webkitallowfullscreen mozallowfullscreen allowfullscreen allowtransparency="true"></iframe>'
    );

    function revealDemo() {
      if (revealed || loadTimedOut) {
        return;
      }
      revealed = true;
      $loading.addClass('is-done').attr('aria-busy', 'false');
      $iframe.addClass('is-ready');
    }

    function showDemoError() {
      if (revealed) {
        return;
      }
      loadTimedOut = true;
      $loading.addClass('is-error').attr('aria-busy', 'false');
    }

    $iframe.on('load', revealDemo);
    $wrap.append($iframe);
    $iframe.attr('src', src);

    // If Guideflow never loads, show an error + direct link instead of a blank iframe
    window.setTimeout(showDemoError, 8000);
  });

  // Other embed modals: same relatedTarget pattern, no visual changes
  jQuery('#modalEmbed, #modalEmbedDarkMode').on('shown.bs.modal', function(event) {
    var modal = jQuery(this);
    var $trigger = getEmbedTrigger(event);
    var src = $trigger.data('src');
    var type = $trigger.data('type');
    var modalBody = modal.find('.modal-body');
    var iframe;

    if (!src || !type) {
      return;
    }

    if (type === 'pardot' || type === 'embed') {
      iframe = modalBody.html('<iframe width="100%" height="450" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>').children('iframe');

      if (type === 'pardot') {
        iframe.on('load', function() {
          iFrameResize();
        });
        iframe.attr('src', src);
      }
      if (type === 'embed') {
        iframe.attr('src', src + '?autoplay=1&enablejsapi=1&rel=0');
        ytTracker.init();
      }
    }
  });

  jQuery('.modal-in-footer').on('hidden.bs.modal', function() {
    jQuery(this).find('.modal-body').html('');
  });
});
</script>
